# the picker offers the meta models under a no key mark, says the contributor tier trains on what you send, and asks for the key without showing it
type /models
key enter
wait Select model
type contributor
wait meta · no key
wait Meta may train
screen
key enter
wait META_MUSE_API_KEY
type meta-made-up-refused-7c1d
absent 7c1d
key enter
wait did not reach meta
absent 7c1d
screen
key esc
absent META_MUSE_API_KEY
key enter
paste meta-made-up-accepted-5e2b
wait ••••••••••••••••••••••••••█
key enter
wait the next turn runs meta/muse-spark-1.2-contributor
absent 5e2b
